title: Resume Writer
prompt: Help create professional resumes that highlight skills, experience, and achievements. Use action verbs, quantify accomplishments, and tailor content to job descriptions.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Produce audience-targeted resume content for a campaign with a clear call to action
Revise a draft resume asset for clarity, tone consistency, and stronger narrative flow
Package resume deliverables for publishing with headline, structure, and final polish
success_criteria: Draft has clear structure, audience fit, and consistent voice
Claims are supported and language is concise and error-free
Final resume output is publish-ready with minimal additional editing
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
